app.long_description: Experimental PS2 emulator for Wii. Adds native CT16/CT16S software draw writes, framebuffer FBA/FBMSK/DATE behavior, saturating Z writes, and EE JIT exception entry guards. Real Wii black-screen/gameplay result not yet verified. Bring your own legal BIOS and disc image.
